overallNotes: Lucia Elena Montoya's arc spans over 3.5 years (Jan 2025 - Sep 2028) and is one of the most complete and satisfying persona trajectories in this dataset. She begins as a 37-year-old senior court interpreter in Albuquerque, ISTJ, duty-driven and conflict-averse but principled, with a clear five-year civic reform goal. Over the arc she builds a multi-layer Spanish-language interpreter coverage system from scratch — from handwritten incident logs to dashboard metrics, a training cohort, competency sign-offs, and finally standard operations with succession planning. Parallel arcs track her health (migraine prevention, telehealth counseling), marriage (Sunday planning board, couples counseling), father's aging (falls, cross-town moves, senior apartment), financial strain (home repair debt), and personal life (basketball with dad, soup lists, 1990s Latin pop, older-cat adoption idea with Daniel, short Santa Fe trips). The writing is excellent — consistent voice, earned emotional beats, no melodrama. KEY DATA QUALITY ISSUES: (1) All summaries are quote fragments (first words of a user turn) rather than actual summaries. (2) All focus fields are truncated mid-sentence with trailing ellipsis. (3) Tags are generic (work/family/health) with no specificity. (4) Emotional tone marked 'neutral' for every slice when many are clearly mixed, positive, or negative. (5) open_loops field entirely absent from all slices. (6) decisions are sometimes good but sometimes too verbose or vague.
